title: ARGUS LLM spend rate — argus
root_cause: ARGUS's own self-query to the 'changes.deployments' query_range API is malformed, causing repeated failed 400 requests that retry and inflate both throughput and LLM investigation spend. — Each investigation triggers a query_range call for deployment changes; a bad request parameter (e.g. invalid time range or filter syntax) causes a 400 Bad Request. ARGUS likely retries or re-invokes the LLM to reason about the failure, multiplying the number of investigation cycles (and thus argus.cost.usd) per alert, which explains throughput_per_min rising 1.8x while error_rate stays high.
